Videography

Planned around where the video will live.

A website hero film, a 15-second vertical clip for reels and a product demo for a trade show are three different briefs. We start by agreeing the audience, the message and the channels, then build the shot list, locations and deliverables around them so nothing is filmed that will not be used.

Social Clips focuses on short vertical content; Brand Story covers story planning, filming at your business and edits for your website and social channels; Campaign Production is for multi-asset campaigns with channel-specific edits. Every plan is quoted individually once we understand the scope — shoot duration, locations, crew, editing, captions and usage rights all affect the price.

Video works best alongside the rest of your brand. Pair it with social media services for planning and publishing, or film a freshly wrapped fleet — see the vehicle wrap portfolio for the kind of work we produce.

FAQ

Before you get started.

What affects the price?
Shoot duration, locations, crew needs, editing, usage and the deliverables required.
Can we reuse the video on social media?
We can scope versions for your website and social channels. Music and usage rights are agreed as part of the project.
How do we get started?
Send a short brief through the quote form on this page: what the video is for, where it will be used and any deadline. We reply with questions and a written scope and quote before anything is booked.
